title: E2E calibration & regression harness for INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) profiles
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Enable a reproducible end-to-end calibration and regression test harness that validates INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) across our model catalog. Current ad-hoc checks miss subtle quality regressions when we change kernel selection, batching heuristics, or calibration hyperparameters. This ticket introduces a deterministic calibration runner, standardized prompt/seed corpora, and automated acceptance gates in CI/nightly jobs that surface regressions early. Goals: 1) Ensure any change to quant profiles or runtime still meets unit quality thresholds; 2) Provide actionable diagnostics (per-layer error, KL divergence, sample outputs) to speed root cause and rollback; 3) Make the harness fast enough for nightly and canary pipelines and exhaustive enough for weekly long-run regression suites.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic calibration runner that can ingest GPTQ and AWQ profile definitions and produce a canonical 'calibration artifact' (metadata + stats) for a given model version.
Integration into CI: a fast 'smoke' job (<= 30m) that runs on PRs versus a nightly long-run job (<= 4h) that covers a broader prompt set.

Automated quality checks that compare new calibration artifacts against baseline using: KL divergence < 0.04 on activation distributions, token-level perplexity delta < 5% on preset eval prompts, and top-1 generation BLEU/ROUGE thresholds where applicable.
Failure modes produce a triage bundle (calibration logs, per-layer scale/zero-point diffs, representative mismatch generations) and annotate the related PR with links.
Canary rollout orchestration hook for dedicated to use calibrated artifacts to pin models and automatically rollback if regression is detected in production shadow tests.
implementation_plan: Design canonical calibration artifact schema (json + proto) and a lightweight serializer compatible with existing profile registry.
Build calibration runner microservice (python/rust) with pluggable backends for GPTQ and AWQ code paths; include deterministic RNG seed and batch iteration logging.
Create synthetic + real prompt corpora: small smoke set (100 prompts), nightly set (2k prompts), and long-run suite (20k prompts) sampled from live traffic buckets and benchmarks.
Define thresholds and comparison heuristics (statistical tests + heuristics for generation-level quality).
Wire runner into CI: PR-level smoke job and nightly cron that writes artifacts to s3 and updates a baseline index; add Github check output formatter.
Implement regression triage tooling: compare artifacts, compute deltas, and store visual diff report in dashboard.
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration runner deterministic behavior (seeded runs must match across machines).
Integration test that runs GPTQ and AWQ on a small 1B param model and validates artifact schema and comparison pipeline.
PR smoke job (<=30m) using smoke prompt set to validate new quant profile changes in CI.
Nightly job that runs expanded prompt set and raises alert if any metric crosses threshold; outputs dashboard charts for trend analysis.
Weekly long-run regression that exercises edge-case sequences (long contexts, repetitive tokens, adversarial prompts) to catch token-level drift.

postmortem_plan: If regression escapes to staging/production, capture production samples, rerun calibration runner with saved RNG seed, perform per-layer error attribution, rollback pin to previous artifact, and run a hotfix PR that updates failing threshold or fixes kernel mismatch.
triage_runbooks: If KL divergence > threshold: run per-layer activation histogram diff and collect top 10 worst layers; escalate to applied-ml team.
If generation BLEU/ROUGE drops > threshold: run delta generation on smoke prompts and attach representative mismatches to PR.
If smoke job exceeds time budget: capture profiler trace and open ENG-INFRA ticket for runtime optimization.
